Scrapes a simple HTML page and extracts title, description, and links

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.crawlberg.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val engineConfig = mapper.readValue("{\"max_depth\":0,\"respect_robots_txt\":false}", CrawlConfig::class.java)
    val engine = Crawlberg.createEngine(engineConfig)
    val url = "https://example.com"
    val result = Crawlberg.scrape(engine, url)
    println(result.statusCode)
    println(result.contentType)
    println(result.html)
    println(result.metadata.title)
    println(result.metadata.description)
    println(result.metadata.canonicalUrl)
    println(result.links.size)
    println(result.links.first().linkType)
    println(result.images.size)
    println(result.metadata.ogTitle)
}
```
